ReportKey.description: A key that isn't equal on both sides.

status.description: different, left_only or right_only (unknown if a side couldn't be read).
status.title: Status

type_differs.description: The values have different JSON types, e.g. 5432 vs "5432".
type_differs.title: Type Differs

ignored.description: A profile rule says this difference doesn't count.
ignored.title: Ignored

left_holds.description: What the left value is (certificate, keystore...), without the value.
left_holds.title: Left Holds

right_holds.description: What the right value is, without the value.
right_holds.title: Right Holds

action.description: What `lockstep apply` does with this key.
enumDescriptions: Write the left side's value to the right side. The key must exist on the left.
Write the right side's value to the left side. The key must exist on the right.
markdownEnumDescriptions: `copy-to-right`: Write the left side's value to the right side. The key must exist on the left.
`copy-to-left`: Write the right side's value to the left side. The key must exist on the right.
action.title: Action

ReportKey.title: ReportKey

ReportSecret.description: A secret that differs (or every secret, with --include-equal).

path.description: The secret's path relative to the prefixes (the right side's form under a mapping).
path.title: Path

status.description: equal, different, left_only, right_only, no_access or error.
status.title: Status

action.description: What `lockstep apply` does with the whole secret.
enumDescriptions: Use the actions set on this secret's keys (the default).
Leave the whole secret alone, whatever its keys say.
Copy every key the left side has to the right side, including keys that are already equal.
Copy every key the right side has to the left side, including keys that are already equal.
markdownEnumDescriptions: `per-key`: Use the actions set on this secret's keys (the default).
`skip`: Leave the whole secret alone, whatever its keys say.
`copy-to-right`: Copy every key the left side has to the right side, including keys that are already equal.
`copy-to-left`: Copy every key the right side has to the left side, including keys that are already equal.
action.title: Action

note.description: Why the comparison couldn't be completed for this secret.
note.title: Note

equal_keys.description: How many keys are equal (not listed).
equal_keys.title: Equal Keys

keys.description: Keys that differ, each with an action.
keys.title: Keys

ReportSecret.title: ReportSecret

name.description: Label for this side, used in messages.
name.title: Name

addr.description: Vault address. `lockstep apply` connects here unless you pass --left-addr/--right-addr.
addr.title: Addr

prefix.description: Path prefix that was compared (empty: the whole mount).
prefix.title: Prefix

ui_addr.description: Address of the Vault UI, if it differs from addr.
ui_addr.title: Ui Addr

identity.description: Who compared this side (Vault's display name for the token).
identity.title: Identity

SecretSide.description: One side of a secret, as it was when the report was made.

path.description: Full path within the mount (prefix included).
path.title: Path

state.description: present, absent, deleted, no_access or error.
state.title: State

version.description: KV v2 version when compared. `apply` skips the secret if it has changed since.
version.title: Version

ui.description: The secret in the Vault web UI.
ui.title: Ui

cli.description: Command to see its values with the vault CLI.
cli.title: Cli

SecretSide.title: SecretSide
